assets.prompt: Edit the original 4x4 16-pose baby otter walk sheet. Preserve two eyes, brown and cream fur, 16 distinct poses, proportions and foot positions. Use the reference green cape with gold wave pattern, edging and clasp. Draw the cape attached to neck and shoulders in each complete 2D character cel, moving naturally with the walk. One animal per cell, transparent background, clear cell margins, no extra body parts or text.

Edit the adult otter 4x4 sixteen-pose walk sheet; preserve adult face, two eyes, brown and cream fur, body proportions, tail, feet and pose order. Apply the sage-green short gold-wave cape and gold leaf clasp from the adult reference as part of each whole 2D cel, attached at the shoulders and draping naturally. Transparent background, 4x4 separated cells, no clipping, no parts, no 3D or text.

Edit the baby raccoon 4x4 idle sheet; preserve the two dark eyes and eye masks, striped tail, blue neckerchief, taupe and cream fur and sixteen poses. Transparent background, exact 4x4 grid, clear margins, no separate parts or extra anatomy.
